en.title: Dane Cook Stars in New Horror Short from 'Obsession' Director's Father
en.summary: Comedian Dane Cook is set to headline a new psychological horror short film titled 'Medium Rare.' The project marks a directorial debut for Jeff Barker, father of 'Obsession' director Curry Barker.
en.body:
The independent film scene is abuzz with news of a new horror short that promises to deliver chills and thrills. **Jeff Barker**, a screenwriter and the father of the acclaimed **Curry Barker** (director of the recent indie hit **‘Obsession’**), is stepping behind the camera to write and direct his own psychological horror project, titled **‘Medium Rare’**. Adding significant star power to the venture, comedian-turned-actor **Dane Cook** is slated to star in the short film.

This marks a notable shift for Cook, who has primarily been known for his stand-up comedy and more lighthearted acting roles. His involvement in a psychological horror short suggests a desire to explore darker, more dramatic territory, a move that is sure to pique the interest of his established fanbase and horror aficionados alike. The supporting cast is also set to include the talented **Lesley Ann Warren**, an Oscar-nominated actress known for her versatile performances across film and television, further elevating the anticipation for **‘Medium Rare’**.

## A Family Affair in Horror

The connection to **Curry Barker**, whose film **‘Obsession’** garnered attention for its distinctive style and narrative, adds another layer of intrigue. While details about the specific plot of **‘Medium Rare’** are still emerging, the involvement of Jeff Barker as both writer and director, coupled with the pedigree of its cast, points towards a carefully crafted and potentially unsettling cinematic experience. The project is expected to begin filming in Los Angeles later this summer, signaling a swift progression from announcement to production.

## What Fans Can Expect

For fans of **Dane Cook**, this is an opportunity to see him tackle a genre that diverges significantly from his previous work. His ability to command a stage and connect with an audience could translate powerfully into the intimate and often intense world of horror. Similarly, for followers of **Curry Barker** and the broader independent horror community, **Jeff Barker**’s directorial debut is a significant event. It raises questions about the creative influences at play within the Barker family and whether **‘Medium Rare’** will share any thematic or stylistic DNA with **Curry Barker**'s previous work. The combination of a seasoned comedian, an acclaimed dramatic actress, and a filmmaker with a clear familial connection to an emerging directorial voice creates a compelling narrative around the creation of this short.

## What's Next

Filming for **‘Medium Rare’** is slated to commence in Los Angeles this summer. Further details regarding the release strategy and platform for the short film are expected to be announced as production progresses.

content_raw: 'Medium Rare' will also star Oscar-nominated actress Lesley Ann Warren and is expected to begin filming in Los Angeles later this summer.
